scenes.headline: How a product demo can build itself
scenes.sub: A browser run, a voice with timings, frames painted from time.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Clapper! A developer had Claude make a hundred and four product demos. Here's how that pipeline fits together.

scenes.text: Record the browser once, then paint every frame from the time alone. Voice, captions, cursor and mouth all come from timestamps.
scenes.mark: paint every frame from the time alone
scenes.say: Record the browser once. Then paint every frame from the time alone, so the voice, captions, cursor and mouth all follow from timestamps.

steps.say: An agent uses each tool in a real browser and logs when every click happened.
The log fixes how long each step lasts, so the narration is written to fit those slots.
Kokoro speaks each line, and its duration model says exactly where every sound lands.
A painter draws each frame from the time alone, and picture and sound are joined once, at the end.
Inside the drawn window is the recorded page. The real toolbar never appears.
The step title, the checklist and the progress bar are a drawn layer around it.

scenes.title: Two ways to move a mouth

left.title: This site's sine flap
items: Opens and closes on a sine
left.say: Our own film engine just flaps the mouth on a sine wave, and it never closes mid-line.

right.title: Kokoro's phoneme frames
items: Lips shut on p, b and m
right.say: Kokoro gives every phoneme its frames, so lips can close on p, b and m. Our engine computes them, then discards them.

scenes.title: A cursor that moves like a hand

parts.note: how far along the path, from 0 to 1
parts.say: The cursor isn't in the recording, so it gets drawn, along this curve.
It leaves gently, rushes the middle and settles on the button, the way a hand reaches.

scenes.label: how late an even split by word count puts the last word
scenes.say: Timing captions by word count put the last word almost half a second late.

scenes.text: The voice model already knows where every sound lands. Keep its frames, and the mouth and captions follow.
scenes.mark: already knows where every sound lands

recap: Record once, paint every frame from time
Kokoro's frames drive mouth and captions
Draw the cursor with a human ease
scenes.say: To recap: record once and paint from time, let Kokoro's frames drive the mouth and captions, and ease the cursor.
